description: next_id() seeds a global counter from SystemTime::now() nanoseconds. Persistent backends that do not override find_thread_by_message_ids will silently get thread ID collisions if two process instances start within the same nanosecond (common in containers). The doc says 'Persistent backends should override find_thread_by_message_ids' but does not explain that failing to do so produces silent data corruption across restarts.
title: next_id() thread-id collisions across process restarts
